startDelay.title: Start Delay
startDelay.tooltip: The time in seconds Ernesto waits before chasing you.

ernestoNumber.title: Number of Ernestos
ernestoNumber.tooltip: The number of Ernestos to spawn each loop.

ernestoStacking.title: Enable Ernesto Stacking
ernestoStacking.tooltip: Lets Ernestos from previous loops join the hunt.

customEndScreen.title: Custom Death Screen
customEndScreen.tooltip: Turn this on to show a custom death screen when Ernesto catches you. It will also return you to the main menu.

ernestoMorph.title: Enable Ernesto Morph
ernestoMorph.tooltip: Turns you into Ernesto. Maybe they'll stop chasing you now?

randomMode.title: Enable Randomizer
randomMode.tooltip: Randomizes all of the settings each loop. You can customize the randomizer using the RandomizerSettings.json file in the mod folder.

groundMovementSpeed.title: Ground Movement Speed Multiplier
groundMovementSpeed.tooltip: This changes how quickly Ernesto traces your path when you are in a gravity field, like on a planet.

speedAccumulationType.title: Ground Speed Accumulation
speedAccumulationType.tooltip: Controls the way that Ernesto gains speed over time.

speedAccumulationRate.title: Ground Speed Accumulation Rate
speedAccumulationRate.tooltip: Controls how fast Ernesto gains speed over time.

distanceSpeedMultiplier.title: Distance Speed Multiplier
distanceSpeedMultiplier.tooltip: Changes Ernesto's speed based on how far away he is from you. Numbers above 1 make him faster as he gets farther, and numbers below 1 make him slower as he gets farther.

spaceAccelerationType.title: Space Movement Type
spaceAccelerationType.tooltip: Changes Ernesto's mode of transportation in space.

spaceMovementSpeed.title: Space Movement Speed Multiplier
spaceMovementSpeed.tooltip: Changes how quickly Ernesto accelerates towards you in space.

spaceTimer.title: Interception Time
spaceTimer.tooltip: Determines how many seconds it will take for Ernesto to catch up to you in space.

brambleSpeedMultiplier.title: Dark Bramble Speed Multiplier
brambleSpeedMultiplier.tooltip: Larger numbers increase Ernesto's speed in Dark Bramble seeds.

dreamWorldSpeedMultiplier.title: Dream World Speed Multiplier
dreamWorldSpeedMultiplier.tooltip: Larger numbers increase Ernesto's speed in the dream world.

enableStealthMode.title: Enable Stealth Mode
enableStealthMode.tooltip: Makes Ernesto completely silent. You won't know where he is until he's right behind you.

disableLight.title: Disable Light
disableLight.tooltip: Turns off Ernesto's glowing bulb. He won't light up the area around him, but he will also be very hard to see in the dark.

enableQuantumMode.title: Enable Quantum Mode
enableQuantumMode.tooltip: Freezes Ernesto if you can see him, but makes him move a lot faster.

ernestoCam.title: Enable ErnestoCam
ernestoCam.tooltip: Lets you see Ernesto's POV by taking a reverse snapshot with your probe launcher while in photo mode. You can switch between Ernestos with tool up/down.

ernestoMusic.title: Enable Ernesto Music
ernestoMusic.tooltip: Makes Ernesto play music while he chases you. You can change the music he plays in the ErnestoMusic folder in the mod folder.

advancedSettings.title: Enable Advanced Settings
advancedSettings.tooltip: Enabling this will ignore this section of the settings and use the values from the AdvancedErnestoSettings.json file in the mod folder.

allowShipLog.title: Allow Ship Log
allowShipLog.tooltip: Lets you use your ship log while playing the Random Ship Log minigame.

shipLogRounds.title: Number of Rounds
shipLogRounds.tooltip: The number of times to play before winning.

globalFactGoals.title: Global Fact Goals (QSB)
globalFactGoals.tooltip: Gives everyone the same facts. Disable this if you want everyone to hunt their own facts.

survivalTimerLength.title: Timer Length
survivalTimerLength.tooltip: Sets the number of minutes you need to survive for in order to win.
